arms.ALIGNED_RECURSION: same z0; update exact trained F sequentially on causally observed transitions in authenticated order; expose current z at matched G sites
arms.MATCHED_INFORMATION: same z0/F/G/count/timing, but each transition input is replaced by a precommitted in-distribution same-operator donor transition from a different source graph selected by hash before outcomes; preserves feature realism/information volume while removing target-family transition identity
arms.STATIC_ONESHOT: redundant diagnostic: expose trained z0 at the final branch scoring site only; no F update; never a DEVELOPMENT gate
arms.STATIC_REPEAT: same trained z0 exposed at every matched G site; execute F on isolated scratch using same inputs/count but scratch has no path to G
arms.TRANSITION_PERMUTED: same z0, transition multiset, F/G, update/exposure count and timing; after all required transitions have occurred, replay exact precommitted nonidentity order; only order differs

cheapest_kill_test: Train/freeze V5 F/G on TRAIN only and run the CALIBRATION constructibility gate. If aligned predictive loss does not beat both static-z0 and permuted recurrence, or aligned/permuted states collapse, kill this V5 realization before any 33-family DEVELOPMENT GPU execution.
development_endpoint: Reuse exact orientation-invariant V4 branch-preference endpoint: R_g=LSE(A)-LSE(B); D_g=abs(R_g-R_NO_CARRY); C_static=D_ALIGNED-D_STATIC_REPEAT; C_permuted=D_ALIGNED-D_TRANSITION_PERMUTED; C_information=D_ALIGNED-D_MATCHED_INFORMATION.
falsified_prerequisites_not_inherited: fixed-slot textual control constructibility from LocalContinuation

predevelopment_constructibility_gate.data: CALIBRATION only; no V5 DEVELOPMENT/CONFIRMATION endpoint access
requirements: aligned and precommitted-permuted final states nonidentical for every qualifying calibration sequence
median predictive loss ALIGNED < STATIC z0 predictive loss
median predictive loss ALIGNED < TRANSITION_PERMUTED predictive loss
G action residuals finite, bounded [-1,1], and not exactly constant over legal candidate sets
zero branch-label/evaluator/outcome path to training,F,G,or calibration

protected_invariants: whole-action score maps sealed before A/B aggregation
same state/update/exposure budget within matched arms

scope.claim: same CPDS ordered predictive-state mechanism; new F/G realization only

training_and_evaluation_partition.calibration: separate source-graph-disjoint CALIBRATION namespace; used only for predictive loss/constructibility, never V4/V5 branch endpoints
training_and_evaluation_partition.confirmation: fresh exactly 33 V5 CONFIRMATION families frozen before DEVELOPMENT and hard sealed until V5 DEVELOPMENT passes; V4 confirmation remains permanently separate and unopened
training_and_evaluation_partition.development: fresh exactly 33 V5 DEVELOPMENT families, no replacement/resampling/redraw, structurally disjoint from TRAIN/CALIBRATION/V4 DEVELOPMENT/V4 sealed CONFIRMATION/V5 CONFIRMATION
training_and_evaluation_partition.principle: source-graph-disjoint deterministic hash partition before any V5 model fitting or endpoint access
training_and_evaluation_partition.training: all eligible source graphs assigned to TRAIN namespace after excluding every reserved V4 structural key via blind hash-overlap validation
training_and_evaluation_partition.v4_development_use: diagnosis of failed realization only; forbidden for V5 optimizer, hyperparameter, gain, threshold, cohort, or model-selection tuning

orthogonal_two_update_witness.interpretation: Even maximally distinct orthogonal transition vectors produce final aligned/permuted states with cosine about 0.9571.

F_structural_failure.reason: normalized addition is only weakly noncommutative; temporal order enters solely through intermediate normalization rather than an order-sensitive transition operator

G_structural_failure.reason: branch-relevant action differences depend on dot(z,q_a-q_b); any common action-feature component cancels in the V4 LSE branch-ratio endpoint. Standalone canonical-action hidden features have no learned binding to recurrent predictive state.

v4_diagnosis.diagnostic_conclusion: V4 fails primarily because its parameter-free recurrence does not strongly encode temporal order and its raw shared-basis cosine adapter does not learn an action-discriminative state-to-policy binding. Increasing gain alone is forbidden as a rescue.

v5_enabling_method.F: z_t+1=unit_l2(GRUCell256(x_t,z_t)); GRU/W0/Wx are global trained parameters; no evaluator branch labels or evaluation outcomes in training
v5_enabling_method.G: delta(a,z)=dot(z,q(a)); adjusted_whole_action_logscore=base_whole_action_logscore+delta; coefficient fixed exactly 1.0; delta bounded [-1,1]; G is branch-blind and nonexecuting
v5_enabling_method.base_model: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B exact existing frozen revision; weights frozen
v5_enabling_method.name: CPDS_PREDICTIVE_GRU256_BOUNDED_COSINE_V1
v5_enabling_method.optimizer_policy: Freeze exact optimizer/seed/epoch/early-stop recipe before any V5 DEVELOPMENT access; model selection may use training/calibration predictive loss only, never CPDS branch endpoint values.

training_objective.correctness_boundary: The next observed command is behavior-sequence self-supervision only, never evaluator branch correctness or task-optimality evidence.
training_objective.primary: cross-entropy next-observed-command prediction over the legal candidate set on training-only trajectories
training_objective.secondary: contrastive prediction of the next transition native feature from z_t

v5_enabling_method.why_not_gain_only: G retains the V4 fixed unit coefficient and bounded cosine scale, so V5 cannot manufacture the 0.05-nat effect by post-hoc gain amplification.

v5_mechanistic_hypothesis: Within the same CPDS hypothesis, an explicitly order-sensitive recurrent state trained only to predict future transition/action structure on evaluation-disjoint source graphs will retain transition-order information that a fixed z0 cannot, and a bounded learned action projection will convert that state into branch-discriminative policy score changes. Therefore ALIGNED should exceed both STATIC_REPEAT and TRANSITION_PERMUTED on fresh matched graph forks if CPDS ordered predictive state is real.
